verdict.rationale: Latham's own Privacy & Cyber practice page describes a highly ranked, interdisciplinary privacy and cyber practice that provides global compliance and regulatory support. That is directly a documented privacy/data-protection counsel practice. The Technology Transactions team also helps clients build compliant platforms. Missing for 10: explicit naming of specific regimes (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act) or jurisdiction-level detail, independent or third-party corroboration of the practice.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: Our highly ranked, interdisciplinary privacy and cyber practice delivers full-spectrum legal support around the globe, to solve today's complex and dynamic compliance, regulatory, litigation, and transactional challenges.
develop secure and compliant platforms and products, and realize the maximum value of their data and IP assets.
